summary: Deploy new version with state_only migration, add temporary column to preserve referrer_id data, retire old version, clean orphan referrer_id values to NULL, add FK constraint to referrer_id referencing account_user, and drop temporary column.
write_consistency: During the overlap phase (deploy_new to retire_old), the old version continues writing referrer_id as integer; the new version's save() omits referrer_id because its model does not know the column (state_only migration), so PostgreSQL assigns the column's database default (NULL). The temporary column referrer_tmp is unaffected by the old version. Orphan values are cleared after old version retires before the FK constraint is added.
revision_notes: Added orphan cleanup UPDATE and reordered stages: orphan cleanup and FK addition now occur after retire_old in the contract stage to avoid race conditions with the old version writing referrer_id.

stages.description: Add temporary column referrer_tmp to safely preserve referrer_id values during overlap.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN referrer_tmp BIGINT NULL;

stages.description: Copy existing referrer_id values into referrer_tmp.
Clean orphan referrer_id values to NULL, add FK constraint, and drop temporary column.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET referrer_id = NULL WHERE referrer_id IS NOT NULL AND referrer_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM account_user);
ALTER TABLE account_user ADD CONSTRAINT fk_referrer FOREIGN KEY (referrer_id) REFERENCES account_user(id);
ALTER TABLE account_user DROP COLUMN referrer_tmp;
